localizedValues.name: C1
localizedValues.description:
The cabins sit along Mayfield Lake and are within walking distance of the lake. This cabin has a view of Mayfield Lake. Each cabin is 12’x24’ and features a six-foot covered front porch, picnic table, electric heat, lights and locking doors. Restrooms and showers are nearby. Cabins are furnished with bunk beds that sleep three and a full-size bed. Outside is an ADA-compliant deck with fire grill.
Utility hookup for RV/trailer up to 18 feet long is available at the park for a $41 per night. No tents are allowed in the cabin area.
